title: McCasland as Pentagon director of special programs overseeing acquisition SAPs
place_text: Pentagon, Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition, Technology and Logistics

tellings.quote: From June 2009 to May 2011, McCasslin served as director of special programs at the Pentagon [music] in the office of the under secretary of defense for acquisitions, technology, and logistics.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, in an episode about missing American scientists, says that from June 2009 to May 2011 a man named Neil McCasland served as director of special programs at the Pentagon, in the office that handles buying weapons, technology and supplies. Citing McCasland's official Air Force biography and Pentagon training papers, Michels frames this as a post overseeing special access programmes, the most tightly guarded secret projects, which would put McCasland close to any hidden UFO work if such work exists.
